versions.content: Usage of functionPrototypeEmitter If attribute functionPrototypeEmitter is set to "RTE" the RTE shall generate the function prototypes in the Module Interlink Header File. If the attribute is set to any other value or does not exist, the BSW module shall generate and provide the prototype in its header file(s).
